t: Created by the division of Lotharingia in 959, Lorraine was ruled from 1048 to 1737 by the descendants of Gerard of Alsace.
René II’s victory at Nancy in 1477, where Charles the Bold died, secured the duchy between France and the Empire.
French occupations from 1633 and the exchange for Tuscany in 1737 ended its independence; it became French in 1766.
dyk: The last duke, Francis Stephen, married Maria Theresa and became Holy Roman Emperor; their house of Habsburg-Lorraine ruled Austria until 1918.
ev: Lotharingia is divided and Upper Lorraine created
Emperor Henry III grants the duchy to Gerard of Alsace
René II defeats and kills Charles the Bold at the Battle of Nancy
The Treaty of Nuremberg recognises Lorraine as a free duchy
France seizes the Three Bishoprics of Metz, Toul and Verdun
The Treaty of Ryswick restores Duke Leopold
Stanisław Leszczyński dies and Lorraine is annexed to France

f.capital: Nancy; Lunéville under Leopold and Stanisław
f.founder: Frederick I (first duke); Gerard of Alsace (founder of the dynasty)
